templates.na_history: {what} unavailable — fresh listing, history window not yet full ({sessions} sessions on file)
templates.na_no_detectors: detector state unavailable — Tracker state not yet built
templates.trend_pass_standalone: 5d and 20d momentum agree ({m5} / {m20}) — price action coherent
templates.trend_pass_context: 5d momentum {m5} (z {z}) aligned with the expected {dir} move
templates.trend_flat_context: 5d momentum flat (z {z}) — neither aligned nor contradicting the expected {dir} move
templates.trend_caution_context: 5d momentum {m5} (z {z}) mildly against the expected {dir} move
templates.trend_fail_context: tape is fighting the thesis — 5d momentum {m5} (z {z}) against the expected {dir} move
templates.trend_note_undirected: thesis direction unresolved — read as standalone
templates.regime_pass_contracting: vol regime {ratio}× its 90d norm — contracting, quieter than usual
templates.regime_fail_unstable: regime unstable — vol {ratio}× its 90d norm; reads unreliable
templates.residual_caution: β {beta}, r² {r2} — the market model explains little of the daily movement; residual reads no cleaner than the raw move
templates.volume_ctx_early: volume {ratio}× its average — early, market not yet looking
templates.stretch_fail_spent: move may be spent — 20d move {m20} already {z}σ in the expected {dir} direction
templates.stretch_caution_washout: 20d move {m20} is {z}σ against the expected {dir} direction — potential washout
templates.event_pass_far: earnings in {n} sessions — outside the {horizon}-session wall
templates.event_note_sizeable: earnings in {n} sessions, typical move {rhythm} — sizeable event on the horizon
templates.conflict_fail_insider: insider cluster {side} — contradicting the expected {dir} move
templates.conflict_caution_unexplained: unexplained move {move_dir} against the expected {dir} move
templates.conflict_caution_disclosure: disclosure risk open on the name
templates.conflict_pass_undirected: nothing live contradicting the thesis — direction unresolved, only disclosure conflicts scanned
templates.freshness_fail_closed: window closed — {n} sessions since the event; pricing status frozen
templates.freshness_fail_priced: window closed — already priced at the source
templates.setup_read_coiled: Compressed range, quiet volume, no event wall for {evt} sessions
templates.setup_read_coiled_confirmed: Compressed for {n} sessions — vol {regime}× its 90d norm, quiet volume, no event wall for {evt} sessions
templates.setup_read_coiled_event_ahead: Compressed, but earnings in {evt} session{s} — the event resolves it, not the tape
templates.setup_read_quiet_drift_up: Pushing on its own for {n} sessions, market-independent
templates.setup_read_quiet_drift_down: Sliding on its own for {n} sessions, market-independent
templates.setup_read_confirmed_drift_up: Independent move higher with volume building — {n} sessions, {vr}× average
templates.setup_read_confirmed_drift_down: Independent move lower with volume building — {n} sessions, {vr}× average
templates.setup_read_accumulation: Volume arriving for {n} sessions, price flat — someone is building
templates.setup_read_divergence_buy: Insiders accumulating against a falling tape ({m20} over 20 sessions)
templates.setup_read_divergence_sell: Insiders distributing against a rising tape ({m20} over 20 sessions)
templates.setup_read_regime_break: Volatility {ratio}× its own norm — structure unreliable
templates.setup_read_unreadable: The market model explains little of the movement (β {beta}, r² {r2}) — residual reads no cleaner than the raw move
templates.setup_read_unreadable_na: Not enough history to fit the market model — residual reads unavailable
templates.setup_read_event_wall: Earnings in {evt} session{s}, typical move {rhythm} — everything else is noise until then
templates.setup_missing_volume: volume {vr}× average, needs {min}× — no participation yet
templates.setup_missing_event: earnings in {evt} session{s} on {due} — the tape reads through until it prints
templates.setup_missing_regime: vol {ratio}× its 90d norm, needs {max}× or below
templates.setup_readability_low_r2: residual reads weak — the market model explains little (β {beta}, r² {r2}); the structure is measured on price and volume, not residuals
templates.setup_readability_regime: vol regime {ratio}× its 90d norm — measurements are unstable
templates.setup_contradicted: The tape is set up in the opposite direction of the thesis — {setup} reads {dir}, the thesis expects {expected}
templates.tooltip_state_actionable: conditions are consistent enough to test a thesis
templates.tooltip_state_wait: a structure is present but one condition is still missing
templates.tooltip_state_nothing_here: no structure, or the move has already happened
templates.tooltip_state_unreadable: the measurement itself is unreliable here
templates.tooltip_state_contradicted_setup: the tape is set up against the thesis
templates.tooltip_blocked: at least one condition rules out a clean read
templates.tooltip_untracked: not in the Tracker universe — nothing to read
